area: Wave 8 work package zdx-zid-zcc: ZDX, ZIdentity and Client Connector completion
title: ZDX alert history, scores, metrics, cloud path and score analysis; ZIdentity admin entitlements and group members; Client Connector bypass breadth, device details, disable-reason counts and live app profile changes

checks.what: ZDX.9 judges the 14-day alert history and counts the devices each alert touched; no device or person is named
ZDX.10 names an application that never reached a score of 66 in 7 days; ZDX.11 names low availability and slow page fetch; all three are N/A without ZDX
Untrusted ZDX values (NaN, infinity, booleans, text, -1) never count; tenant ids with path characters never reach an API path
The cloud path names no device or person, masks private hop addresses and returns no MAC address or vendor

A ZDX score analysis needs write mode, a writer, the assessor, confirm=true and START ANALYSIS; one start per tenant every 5 minutes and 6 an hour, refused with 429 before sign-in; every start, refusal and stop audited with the actor
ZID.6 reads every admin's entitlements and flags too many full-access or many-service admins; ZID.7 fails on a disabled account that still holds an admin entitlement; people are counted, never named

Group membership changes go through the engine: scope before any read, plan hash, the group's name typed, re-read before each write, read-back, Undo; dynamic groups blocked, disabled accounts not added
ZCC.27 and ZCC.28 flag wildcard, interpreter and whole-drive process bypasses, and IP bypasses wider than /16 or open on every port; N/A when the feature is missing
Device details hide the serial number and external id; the device's one-time passwords never reach the answer
The disable-reason report becomes counts with no person listed; the CSV is spreadsheet-safe; an oversized or unreadable report is refused
checks.standard: ASVS V8.3.4 · ASVS V5.3.10 · CWE-1236 · CWE-400

checks.what: App profiles on or off and allowlisted DNS and tunnel settings are live changes: the profile's name is always typed, no password field is accepted, every value is re-read and read back, Undo restores it
checks.standard: ASVS V11.1.1 · ASVS V8.1.1 · CWE-841 · CWE-915

checks.what: Snapshots capture the new reads only for ticked products, keeping affected devices and group members as ids only
Every new control has a help entry (extension copy identical) and the 2026-10-31 features are marked in whats_new.js

In a real browser on the sample tenant: the ZDX panel draws the cloud path, the fleet page shows device details and counts, every new control takes focus, nothing scrolls sideways at 320px, the panel keeps 4.5:1 contrast, no script error

findings.title: The ZDX score analysis response shape is not declared by the SDK (DeviceApplicationAnalysis has device_id, app_id, t0, t1); the analysis id is assumed to be `id` and the status answer is shown scrubbed
findings.fix: Marked ASSUMED in zdx_insights.py; the status answer is bounded and personal or secret fields are dropped (_safe)

findings.title: web_policy.activate_web_policy carries no on/off value; it is assumed to switch the state, so it is sent only when the state differs and the state is read back
findings.fix: ASSUMED in ops_zcc_live.py; a wrong assumption shows as a read-back mismatch, never as a silent success

findings.title: The ZIdentity user record has no last sign-in time in the SDK; idle admins are counted only when the directory sends one of the assumed time fields, otherwise only disabled accounts are counted and the finding says so
findings.fix: The finding text says when sign-in times are missing
